Hi Malek, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I checked the session and it seems everything started and ended successfully. Here are my findings and be aware of the time difference:
At “our” 15:49 on the 11th May, the session stops due to the SoC reaching 100%. We can see that the EV is requesting 0 A since it's fully charged.
And we can see right after this last log the stop charging request from the EV:
Afterwards, is the problem, the BCB toggle is requesting authentication even though the config is correct.
I will confirm why this happened and come back to you.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: [OURRY 160] ID0423690-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R0 313281750001] Charging Session Issue CRM:02679000253
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
We are experiencing an issue with the fast charger: it refuses to launch charging sessions for two trucks at the same time.
The
"agency side"
of the charger is working properly, but the
"depot exit side"
remains stuck with a solid green light. Please find attached some photos illustrating the situation.
As you can see in the screenshots, the issue was reported to me by email at
9:30 PM on 10/05/2025
.
In my opinion, the actual issue occurred earlier on the same day, around
10/05/2025 at 19:09:35
, before the user sent the email. The session on
DC1
ended at 100% but displayed the message
"Error occurred during charging"
. Meanwhile,
DC2
remained in a fault state up to the present moment.
Additionally, as shown in the screenshots, no charging session was recorded on
DC2
, which suggests there is indeed a technical issue.
We would appreciate your help to better understand the root cause and find a resolution.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob: +33 650 370 485

Bonjour Messieurs,
C’est la deuxième fois qu’un technicien accède au site sans que nous en soyons informés à l’avance. Il ne s’agit pas d’une station-service en libre accès sur autoroute, mais bien d’un entrepôt logistique fermé, avec des procédures et des contraintes d’accès.
Dans ces conditions, il est impossible de garantir le bon déroulement des tests.
Ma question est simple : est-il acceptable d’intervenir sur un site privé sans prévenir ni prendre rendez-vous ?
À l’avenir, merci de nous informer, Janusan et moi, en amont de toute intervention.
Courtoises salutations,
